name: Cedar Avenue Play Area
description: Ripley Town Council's play area on Cedar Avenue, for ages 2 to teens. It has swings (a cradle seat, a group seat and a flat seat), a slide, a roundabout, a see-saw, a rocking horse, a spring whale and a spring car, plus a nine-item trim trail. There's a picnic table, benches and litter bins, and it's open all day, every day.
